chronology: Six 4h epochs comprising one site-day. Public Markov regime tables and initial mark 0 are disclosed before dispatch; at later epochs only the realized current/past binary marks are observed. Issued branch probabilities and next-epoch conditional price/capacity forecasts depend only on decision-time information. No realized leaf, seed or scenario index is a controller argument.
economics: All prices in dollars per quarter MWh. Fixed protected load is 8 to 10 quarter MWh per epoch. Metered ordinary import, unlimited separately priced firm backup and throughput wear. No lost load, export, unserved or differentiated revenue. Terminal inventory exactly 2 MWh; initial 2, capacity 4. One action per epoch in {-1,0,+1} internal MWh; charge 5 quarter MWh, discharge supplies 4, absolute changes at most 1 including initial previous action 0.
baseline: Ex ante cheapest admissible of idle and four exact H12 adaptive rolling policies with terminal inventory slopes 0,11,24,40 $/MWh, selected by exact expectation under the public scenario law. All five are checked; no realized future is used. Fixed tie order idle then listed slopes. Global endpoint recoverability.
risk: Expected total matched procurement and wear, all protected service covered pathwise, endpoint equal on every positive-weight leaf.
threshold: inclusive max($15/site-day,0.01*abs(exact baseline expected cost)); strict ceiling < threshold excludes, equality remains attainable
stopping: First strict exclusion using running maximum of checked lower values, else direct exact causal solve; report terminal reachable target with a policy. Missing baseline retains original family weight with status unknown.
audit: Independent leaf-group rational Bellman checker for each issued certificate; complete action/branch enumeration and uniform local centering; compare native feasible policy by exact replay, label native dual numerical. Leakage probes include future suffix mutation, repeated-prefix action checks, and leaf-order invariance.
timing: One separately launched cold process per arm and family in deterministic rotating arm order. Include law/baseline generation, exact checking, native build, verification, JSON and process startup. Report worker clocks, parent elapsed and lifetime peak RSS; no learned/precomputed value tables. A separate all-tier shadow audit gets no timing credit.
scope: Designed seed-family average only. Public tariff laws with synthetic binary innovations and a fully specified finite alphabet; no field-frequency inference, reserve deliverability, deployment or system-cost claims.
positive_control: Positive stratum has protected tariff spike outside initial H12 horizon. Independently score predeclared feasible commands (+1,+1,0,0,-1,-1) against the selected portfolio, as well as separately constructed analytical controls at strict equality.
